study.question: Does a zero-initialized additive compact-evidence correction improve the frozen match-group model recipe, and do count multiplicity and continuous one-day freshness each add utility beyond action-cell presence under identical correction capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: static/pooled/DIN AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861; compact evidence reaches 0.6186637742 and match groups 0.6187998914. The round-6 full combination reaches 0.6185907798, below the stronger ancestor and below global_evidence 0.6187174166. Its grouped evidence increment is +0.0003041114 versus +0.0015748810 globally, a negative factorial interaction of about -0.001271. Grouped full Logloss 0.1960147054 is also worse than grouped redundant 0.1959841892; wall time rises from ancestor 560.53s to 599.47s and throughput falls from 203493/s to 180339/s. The widened input head changed backbone initialization, capacity and conditioning, so this does not refute complementarity. Provisional mechanism: a separate low-capacity additive correction can expose count multiplicity and conditional freshness while preserving the original backbone allocation and exact initial logits. This is a discriminating implementation follow-up, not evidence that the previous failure was caused by fusion or that residual readouts are novel.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local combined model: inherits its exact all/category/brand/joint by four-action count and mean exp(-age/86400) blocks. Replaces its widened shared head with an unchanged incumbent head plus a 1056-parameter additive correction. Historical comparison changes readout topology and parameter count together, so it is not an isolated topology effect.

Exact parent embedding/action/recency/dormant-scorer/main-head construction order, group means and N/C/B/J scalars retained. New numeric evidence branch allocated after parent modules; zero final weight gives identical initial logits with the same host seed. All modules train from scratch; no claim of identical fitted parent checkpoint.

DIN already uses target-conditioned weighted summation and explicitly preserves interest intensity by avoiding softmax. No count-preservation priority claim. Here the backbone uses deterministic bucket-equality group means and the new branch uses explicit count/conditional-age scalars, without executing a neural event scorer. This is not an exact DIN reproduction.

Author README confirms category/brand/action histories lack item identifiers. No item identity or publisher full-paper reproduction is assumed. Missing full-paper access limits nearest-work verification; global novelty remains unverified.

inherited_components: Exact incumbent Model backbone from history_g1_r0005_match_groups.py, including dormant attention allocation; four disjoint bucket-equality group means and normalized log N/C/B/J.

Exact round-6 _evidence method: 16 overlapping all/category/brand/joint x pv/cart/fav/buy counts, log1p normalization by log129, and mean one-day exponential freshness. Only supplied causal last <=128 events; missing zero IDs never match.
Frozen host data identity, information boundary, natural prevalence, 3-epoch coverage, optimizer/loss, seed and validation selection; no test feedback.

All observed branches retained in reasoning, including weaker feature/pooling/attention baselines and all four unsuccessful round-6 improvements over the incumbent. No failed runtime receipt is reported in the supplied history; previous_runtime_error is null.
study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free 32->32 ReLU ->1 evidence-only correction after all unchanged parent modules and sum its logit with the original head. Zero-initialize only the final correction weight; exact parent initial logits are preserved without checkpoint loading. Full cell F11 inputs [C,T]; F10 [C,P]; F01 [log1p(P)/log129,T]; F00 [log1p(P)/log129,P], where P is exact 16-cell presence. This 2x2 tests multiplicity and age information while holding presence and allocation fixed. F00 intentionally contains action-cell presence beyond the parent; any F00 gain cannot be credited to multiplicity or continuous freshness. All four compute C,T,P and alternatives. Bias-free layers guarantee identically zero correction for empty histories. New total parameters expected 17137987 (1056 above parent; 3040 below round-6 wide model); host measurement is authoritative.
predictions: F11 should exceed the stronger observed source g1-r0005-match_groups (AUC 0.6187998914) and compact source g0-r0000-count_freshness (0.6186637742), with secondary unweighted Logloss reported even if it disagrees. A positive tiny single-seed difference is only a screening observation.

If continuous age is useful beyond counts and occupancy, AUC(F11)-AUC(F10)>0 and preferably AUC(F01)-AUC(F00)>0. T is replaced by P, its exact zero-age counterpart; this preserves cell occupancy. Count C already determines P in F11/F10.

If count multiplicity is useful beyond presence, AUC(F11)-AUC(F01)>0 and preferably AUC(F10)-AUC(F00)>0. Report all four contrasts and interaction AUC(F11)-AUC(F10)-AUC(F01)+AUC(F00); do not assume independent additivity.

No new embedding lookup or neural event scoring is introduced. Wall/GPU time, examples processed, memory and inference throughput/p50/p95 must be measured rather than inferred from parameter count. The candidate is not expected to beat the ancestor on all cost dimensions.

Exploratory first-512 diagnostics should show exact coverage/count identities, empty and zero-length consistency, zero empty correction and padding invariance; continuous freshness in [0,1]. Larger full-validation slices retain frozen bins and sample/positive/negative counts, with insufficient slices flagged.
falsifiers: If F11 fails to exceed the stronger frozen source, practical complementarity remains unsupported for this implementation even if some internal contrasts are positive.

If F11 does not improve F10, or gains come only from F00, continuous freshness beyond counts/presence is unsupported. If F11 does not improve F01, count multiplicity beyond presence/freshness is unsupported.

If improvements disappear across paired validation seeds 42/43/44 or user-cluster intervals include meaningful negative effects, retain preliminary or null conclusions; one seed establishes no significance.
Violations of padding, group/count identities, finite logits or zero empty correction invalidate execution evidence until fixed; failed and retry costs remain charged.

If extra cost dominates tiny gains, do not assert efficiency from small parameter growth. If only a historical comparison with early concatenation improves, attribution to readout topology remains unresolved because topology and capacity differ.
alternative_explanations: Round-6 negative interaction may reflect sampling, validation checkpoint selection or seed variation rather than competing evidence sources.
Changed early-concatenation fan-in/initialization, redundant inputs and scale conditioning could explain the previous regression; the present study cannot isolate all those causes retrospectively.
Presence alone or nonlinear transforms of existing group totals may explain improved predictions; F00 makes this visible and the factorial conditions on exact action-cell occupancy.

Bucket collisions, coarse field identity, unknown static-snapshot dates and history truncation can limit transfer. First-512 visible-count saturation 0.8515625 is a supplied diagnostic, not an estimate of the full population.
One-day decay may be misspecified or largely redundant with group recency embeddings; a negative result rejects this concrete correction and timescale, not every temporal mechanism.

Zero last-layer weights delay first-layer correction gradients by one optimizer step; all cells share this condition. Bias-free additive structure may underfit feature-history interactions, and later backbone optimization still differs.
Fixed-recipe comparison is mechanism screening, not an equal-compute frontier. No matched-compute quality claim or population-wide significance will be inferred from source checks.

cost_plan.stop_rule: Stop at the host trial cap, exhausted total budget or integrity failure; never increase limits. knowledge_assessments.rationale: Reviewed supplied latest knowledge usage and round-6 outcomes, resolved source card and read primary arxiv:2609.16548v1 section 5.2 lines 224-231. Its query-generation ablation does not diagnose our observed combination regression; task/split and capacity differ. The prior declared consideration executed deterministic evidence, not QueryFormer query probes. No evidence establishes knowledge-caused performance gains.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None: no generated queries, packed multiview attention or field-sequence bridge. The correction/factorial is motivated by the local failed combination and its changed main-head allocation.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Unchanged deterministic match-group backbone with an evidence-only additive correction; not a QueryFormer reproduction or transferred ablation result.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Revisit query construction only if a separate local capacity-matched query replacement identifies a retrieval limitation under this same information and cost boundary.
